knowledge.title: Conversion drop triage
knowledge.content: For conversion drop, segment by traffic source, device, product page and checkout step. Validate price, coupon eligibility and page latency before increasing traffic spend.

knowledge.title: Traffic anomaly playbook
knowledge.content: For traffic drop, compare paid, organic, affiliate and returning-user cohorts. Check campaign delivery, ranking changes, content cadence and attribution breaks.

knowledge.title: Stockout risk control
knowledge.content: Prioritize replenishment by expected lost contribution, supplier lead time and substitution rate. High-impact purchase or replenishment operations require human approval.

knowledge.title: Low ROI campaign handling
knowledge.content: When campaign ROI is low, verify conversion tracking and marginal ROI first. Pause or budget changes are reversible but still require approval when spend impact is material.

knowledge.title: Refund rate diagnosis
knowledge.content: Split refunds by reason, SKU, supplier, warehouse and carrier. Preserve demand-side metrics while isolating fulfillment and product-quality causes.
